Title: ICyrenaFileExporter - Cyrena File Export Contract
Summary: Contract for exporting conversation files as a .cyrena zipped archive with manifest info. Kernel-locked service.
Content:
## ICyrenaFileExporter

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Exports conversation files as a `.cyrena` zipped archive with manifest info to process such files. Kernel-locked (one instance per chat).

### Interface
```csharp
public interface ICyrenaFileExporter
{
    Task<CyrenaFileManifest> ExportFilesAsync(
        string extensionId, 
        Version extensionVersion, 
        string importerId, 
        Dictionary<string, string?> properties, 
        string outPath, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### Methods

#### ExportFilesAsync
Creates a `.cyrena` zipped archive containing the exported data.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `extensionId` | `string` | ID of the extension that created the file |
| `extensionVersion` | `Version` | Version of the extension |
| `importerId` | `string` | ID of the `ICyrenaFileImporter` that can re-import this file |
| `properties` | `Dictionary<string, string?>` | Custom properties to include in the manifest |
| `outPath` | `string` | Output file path for the `.cyrena` archive |
| `cancellationToken` | `CancellationToken` | Cancellation token |

**Returns**: `Task<CyrenaFileManifest>` - The generated manifest

### Usage
```csharp
var exporter = kernel.GetRequiredService<ICyrenaFileExporter>();
var properties = new Dictionary<string, string?>
{
    ["document.title"] = "My Document",
    ["document.type"] = "canvas"
};
var manifest = await exporter.ExportFilesAsync(
    "cyrena.canvas", 
    new Version(1, 0), 
    "canvas.importer",
    properties,
    "/path/to/output.cyrena"
);
```

### Related
- `ICyrenaFileImporter` - Imports files exported by this contract
- `CyrenaFileManifest` - The manifest model used in exports
- `ChatConfiguration` - May trigger exports on chat operations
